title: The normalized two-term quotient scalar-extension triangle
statement: For a ring-sheaf homomorphism phi:R→S on the pro-etale site of a scheme T [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower], assume a short exact coefficient sequence 0→R --f--> R --p--> Res(S)→0 with p(1)=1 on every object. Every unbounded derived R-complex K admits a distinguished triangle K --a--> K --eta--> Res^D(L Ext(K)) --> K[1], with its normalized derived scalar-adjunction unit as second arrow. The tensor-unit comparison conjugates H^q(a) to tensoring f with H^q(K). The cokernel of H^q(a) is isomorphic to Res(Ext(H^q(K))), with cokernel projection equal to the ordinary scalar-adjunction unit.

source.place: Proof steps 1 and 3: the two-term completed quotient resolution, its derived triangle, and ordinary cokernel normalization before applying long exact cohomology.

proof.text: Tensor the coefficient sequence with an arbitrary module. Construct the unit and quotient tensor comparisons by sheafifying their sectionwise tensor maps. The equation p(1)=1 identifies the resulting quotient map with the normalized ordinary scalar-adjunction unit. Tensor preserves colimits, hence the sequence is right exact; for a flat module it is short exact. The cokernel comparison is therefore an isomorphism for every module, normalized by the ordinary unit.

Choose a flat-term K-flat resolution of a cochain representative of K. Apply the preceding short exact sequence degreewise. Mathlib triangleOfSES_distinguished constructs its distinguished triangle. The K-flat scalar counit and the specified normalization of the derived adjunction identify its second arrow with the derived unit. Transport the triangle to K along the resolution isomorphism. Tensor multiplication is a natural endomorphism of the identity; homologyMap_eq_app_homology identifies its action on cohomology. Transport the right-exact cokernel isomorphism from the first step along this equality.

proof_origin.place: Proof steps 1 and 3: general two-term quotient coefficient resolution, scalar-extension triangle and ordinary cokernel normalization.

from.place: The coefficient quotient triangle and its normalization, before long exact cohomology.

lean.statement:
theorem pbc_adic_reduction_triangle
    (T : Scheme.{u}) {R S : Sheaf (ProEt.topology T) CommRingCat.{u + 1}}
    (φ : R ⟶ S)
    (f : SheafOfModules.unit ((adicLisseForget T).obj R) ⟶
      SheafOfModules.unit ((adicLisseForget T).obj R))
    (p : SheafOfModules.unit ((adicLisseForget T).obj R) ⟶
      (pbcRestrict φ).obj (SheafOfModules.unit ((adicLisseForget T).obj S)))
    (hp : ∀ V : T.ProEtᵒᵖ, p.val.app V (1 : R.obj.obj V) = (1 : S.obj.obj V))
    (hzero : f ≫ p = 0) (hS : (ShortComplex.mk f p hzero).ShortExact)
    (K : DerivedCategory (pbcModules T R)) :
    ∃ (a : K ⟶ K)
      (w : (pbcDerivedRestrict φ).obj ((pbcDerivedExtend φ).obj K) ⟶ K⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧),
      Pretriangulated.Triangle.mk a ((pbcDerivedScalarAdjunction φ).unit.app K) w ∈
        distTriang _ ∧
      ∀ q : ℤ,
        let H := (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj K
        (∃ e : H ≅ (SheafOfModules.siteSheafTensorRight
            (J := ProEt.topology T) (A := R) H).obj
              (SheafOfModules.unit ((adicLisseForget T).obj R)),
          (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).map a ≫ e.hom =
            e.hom ≫ (SheafOfModules.siteSheafTensorRight
              (J := ProEt.topology T) (A := R) H).map f) ∧
        ∃ e : cokernel ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).map a) ≅
            (pbcRestrict φ).obj ((pbcExtend φ).obj H),
          cokernel.π ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).map a) ≫ e.hom =
            (pbcScalarAdjunction φ).unit.app H
